# Hand-off fixtures

`grep-table-before.json` holds the "Hard-rule greps" section of `orchestration.md` for a grid of 192 stacks,
principle sets and risk classes, as the code wrote it before the patterns and aliases moved to the catalogue file
`prompts/catalogue/grep-rules.v1.yaml` (card P6-28, RF-640, DEC-190). `render-grep-table-before-after.test.ts` compares
today's output with it, apart from the rows marked "checked by reading".

## Provenance (RNF-009)

The file was generated by this repository's own code from made-up stack answers and the catalogue entries of this
repository, by the Rosetta contributors, and is covered by the repository's MIT licence.

Nothing here comes from the owner's employer (DEC-03).
